summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private helpers _resolve_path and _resolve_field), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection with tilde underline in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities entry, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Nothing was run, per instructions. Line lengths were measured: no line in the three Python files exceeds 120 columns. Black and flake8 were not run. Nothing was committed. Choices made: non-object top-level JSON and non-list values under the key raise ValueError; malformed JSON surfaces as json.JSONDecodeError, a ValueError subclass; existence is checked with os.path.isfile.
